device_label: 1 mm CC-SOH MZM, BaTiO3 high-k slotline
epitaxy_or_stack: Si slot waveguide on 220 nm SOI: rails 200 nm wide, slot 100 nm, strip waveguide 500 nm wide; amorphous BaTiO3 slabs 150 nm thick, 1 um wide between slot waveguide and gold electrodes (n 1.85 at 1550 nm); 2 um buried oxide
modulation_format: OOK (64 and 100 GBd); PAM4 (64 and 100 GBd)
driver: 120 GSa/s AWG (45 GHz analog bandwidth) with RF amplifier (Centellax UA1L65VM); 50 ohm termination; digital pre-compensation
notes: Single device characterized; the paper does not explicitly restate that the Sec. 4 data chip is the Fig. 2 chip (tag device_identity_unresolved), so system results sit on this row. Bandwidth: 3 dB on detected RF power (phase-modulation index down by 1/sqrt2), referenced to zero frequency, 50 ohm terminated, photodiode/probes de-embedded; 6 dB means photocurrent power down by 4; 3 dB value read on a noisy plateau. Wavelength 1550 nm is nominal (Eq. S13; data run near 1550 nm); wavelength of the Vpi and EO-response measurements is not stated. Drive about 1 Vpp: reference plane (amplifier output vs device) not stated; do not rank across rows without a plane tag. BER: 64 GBd OOK below 1e-6 (no errors in about 1e6 symbols); 100 GBd OOK 4e-6; 64 GBd PAM4 5e-5; 100 GBd PAM4 9e-3 (electrical back-to-back 1.7e-3). Operating point set by wavelength via 80 um arm imbalance, DC bias fine-tuning; EO response corrected for photodiode, probes, cables. Vpi measured at low frequency; no RF Vpi. Fiber-to-fiber loss includes grating couplers (about 5 dB each) and about 3 dB other passive loss; no on-chip-only number stated. In-device r33 about 34 pm/V (authors, from Vpi*L). Measured BTO film: eps_r about 18, tan delta about 0.05 at 60 GHz; BTO dielectric loss 0.58 dB/mm at 50 GHz. Authors' predictions not entered: velocity-mismatch 3 dB bandwidth about 220 GHz (derived), 1 um gold line bandwidth far beyond 100 GHz (simulated). Not reported: extinction ratio, on-chip optical power, Z0 value, electrode gap, energy per bit, RF Vpi, temperature.
